title: PM-Eng decision radar & 1:1 prep (API/Console/Dedicated/Private)
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Eng Lead (Liam) — prep notes and quick decision radar
Date (planned): 2026-03-13 — 30m slot before sprint-planning
Primary goal: unblock rollout choices for next two weeks + align on risks for Dedicated capacity changes. Keep this tight: 4 quick asks, 2 escalations, 3 follow-ups.

Context snapshot (one-liners):
- Hosted API traffic bump: +18% q/q, tail latency regressed 50ms at p95 after model swap. Ops suspects batching config + model variant.
- Console rollout for route-level tracing: small infra change but impacts billing trace tags (needs opt-in).
- Dedicated customers: 2 pilot customers asking for predictable burst window beyond current reserved pool (June renewal).
- Private installs: customer A wants HSM integration and longer audit retention; legal asking for timeline.

Decision radar (quick map; Need decision now / Try to defer / Ask engineering to prototype):
1) Rollback hosted model variant vs tweak batching (priority: high, impact: high, risk: medium) — ASK: choose rollback or apply conservative batching patch and monitor for 48h.
2) Console tracing opt-in UX: (priority: med, impact: med, risk: low) — DEFERRABLE to next sprint if we can ship opt-in banner.
3) Dedicated burst policy: (priority: high, impact: high, risk: high on cost) — NEED decision on policy (paid burst vs limited soft-burst).
4) Private HSM timeline: (priority: med, impact: med-high, risk: compliance) — PROTOTYPE gating: get PoC with key vendor; avoid full rollout commitment without SRE signoff.

Notes / talking points (to surface quickly):
- For hosted model tail: we have metric diffs (p50/p95/p99) across model variants. Suggest: short rollback to previous variant for 24-48h, plus a canary of the new variant with stricter batching limits (max batch size X, max latency 200ms).
- Rollback implications: customers on newer variant might get different token costs/quality; need comms plan. Who owns comms? Product -> Solutions Eng for key enterprise.
- Console tracing: tiny schema change in telemetry tags (billing provider needs mapping). Opt-in reduces blast radius. Ask: can we ship opt-in flag gated by account-level feature flag this sprint?
- Dedicated burst: two pilots request guaranteed 1.5x burst for 2 hours/day. Options: (A) reserve warm nodes (costly), (B) paid burst credits, (C) soft best-effort with SLAs only for sustained usage. Recommend B until June renewal.
- Private HSM: legal wants timeline; engineering needs to evaluate HSM vendor cert matrix and deploy changes to kube-operator. Realistic: 6–9 weeks for PoC + tests.

Data points to bring (prep checklist):
- p95/p99 latency charts (hosted) for last 7 days — ask Ops to pin to the meeting.
- Batching config diffs between variants (config ids).
- Billing delta estimate for rollback (delta tokens * per-token cost) — finance quick calc.
- Ticket list: pilot requests for Dedicated (JIRA INF-3408, INF-3410).
- Private HSM compliance questionnaire (legal doc id).

Proposed asks (I will lead unless noted):
- Aisha: propose rollback + canary plan + comms bullets (Decision: rollback now vs patch) — ETA: decision in meeting.
- Liam: quick engineering feasibility for canary batching patch + estimate to revert (if rollback chosen) — ETA: 48h follow-up.
- Noah: prepare short comms draft for affected customers and changelog blurb — ETA: same day.
- Priya: cost delta estimate for Dedicated burst options (A/B/C) — ETA: 2 days.
- SRE (ask during meeting): risk review for HSM PoC and any infra blockers — request SRE owner.

Action items (explicit, assign, due):
- Decision: rollback hosted model variant for 24h + canary new variant with conservative batching — OWNER: Aisha (coordinate), ENGINEER: Liam, DUE: 2026-03-14 09:00
- Create canary runbook + alert thresholds (oncall playbook snippet) — OWNER: Liam, DUE: 2026-03-14 EOD
- Draft customer comms for rollback and monitoring plan — OWNER: Noah, DUE: 2026-03-14 12:00
- Run cost simulation for Dedicated burst options and recommend policy — OWNER: Priya, DUE: 2026-03-15
- Open HSM PoC ticket and add SRE reviewer + compliance checklist — OWNER: Aisha, COLLABORATORS: Priya, DUE: 2026-03-20

Open questions / risks to raise in 1:1 (for Liam):
- Do we have quick flags to throttle batching server-side without a deploy? If yes, could avoid rollback.
- If rollback happens, what's the rollback-to variant scaling behavior? Will it pressure caches?
- Who is the SRE owner for the HSM PoC? Do we have vendor contacts ready?

Notes to self (scratchy):
- Keep meeting <30m. Start with hosted rollback decision (10m), then Dedicated policy (10m), then quick HSM timeline + console tracing (5-10m).
- Bring one pager with impact numbers — bullet list only.
- Call out customer renewals (June) as leverage for burst policy negotiation.

Follow-ups to add to weekly sync after 1:1:
- Status update on rollback/canary and any customer-facing incidents.
- Dedicated policy proposal for product review meeting next Tue.
- HSM PoC kickoff note and architecture draft for legal review.

Random TODOs (scratch):
- Ping Ops Slack #infra-alerts to pin p95 chart before meeting.
- Add confluence link to decision doc after meeting and tag "actioned".
- If rollback chosen, schedule quick cross-team sync (SRE, SolutionsEng, Support).

End of scratchpad. Keep this lightweight — convert to formal decision note after meeting.
